notes.title: The Real Final Update?! And now available on Nintendo Switch!
notes.content:
Happy 2025, we're back for one more update! [b]Version 1.1's major addition is a Japanese localization![/b] We had to update some fonts in the game to accommodate this, so you might notice that change too. We also fixed various bugs that we noticed and polished some things a little more.

Part of the motivating factor for this update was... [url=https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/sunshower-switch/][b]Sunshower is available now on Nintendo Switch![/b][/url]

Thanks to everyone who supported us this far, and [b]please let us know what you thought of the game in a review![/b] 

We hope you'll look forward to what we're working on next in [b]our new RPG, GNOMONIC. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1369480/GNOMONIC/]Wishlist it!![/url][/b] The first part of the game will be released on Steam and Nintendo Switch this year, and we'll be [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/nokogodo/whatisagnomon]running a Kickstarter campaign for the game[/url] shortly after that releases. Maybe you'll learn more about Sunshower in GNOMONIC? Hope you'll try it when it's ready!

notes.title: Final Major Update & Full Release Coming November 1st!
notes.content:
We're finally releasing the last major Sunshower update, version 1.0, on November 1st! This update will bring the game out of early access into a full release!!

Thanks to the musical efforts of Shane Mesa and SupaBubba, new music will play as you progress to high scores! Shane even redid our original tracks for the game, so everything sounds like new. I hope you enjoy it, it sounds so good!! The soundtrack for the game will be available for free on Steam, Bandcamp, and most music streaming platforms after the update releases.

One new unlockable mode will be added too: Eclipsed Mode! The look, feel, and sound of this mode are inspired by LCD games. It's also a little more difficult compared to the main mode because there aren't any power-ups for you to use, and you won't be able to rebound your plant off of the walls either. After you get the basics of the game down, keep your eye on the title screen for something new after your playthroughs so you can try it!

We'll also be adding support for macOS in this next update so even more people will be able to play! Aside from all that, there have been minor tweaks and fixes to v0.9 to improve the game even more.

Thanks for supporting us during Early Access and we hope you'll look forward to the release of the demo for our next game: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1369480/GNOMONIC/]GNOMONIC[/url]! Enjoy, and please, let us know what you thought of Sunshower in an honest review of the game after you've played it!! We're also planning a special event for the game soon after the release, so stay tuned for more info!

notes.title: Patch Notes for v0.9
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added tons of new background elements.
[*] Added 8 collectible paint jobs. Catch them when they drop during play. The higher you score the more types can show up.
[*] Added 3 new powerups:
1. Light-speed drop: Collect to increase your speed.
2. Prism drop: Lets your vine skewer up to 3 drops at once. Protects you from one hit.
3. Willow umbrella: Prevents one drop from hurting you. Revives a friend in co-op.
[*] Added new information to the records area, including a help section, credits, and a paint job collection.
[*] New acheivements, and some updated ones. Fixed bugs related to acheivement progress.
[*] Added options for volume and a fullscreen toggle.
[*] Split the co-op and single player leaderboards. Reset leaderboards.
[*] Added global drop counter. How much rain can we all collect?
[*] Made changes to improve the pacing of the game with new powerups.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for v0.5
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Sound effects are implemented!
[*] Multiplayer! Use a second controller or the right half of your keyboard to play locally with a friend. While in 2P mode, player 1 uses WASD + spacebar and player 2 uses arrows + right control key.
[*] Mouse buttons work to shoot now, and W works as a pause.
[*] Added a status indicator to the UI, which will​ work more with the power-ups that will be added before the game is finalized.
[*] Various aesthetic and gameplay flow updates.
[/list]

notes.title: Leaderboard Fix!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where leaderboard scores were saving, but not appearing in-game!
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for v0.1.5
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Steam Leaderboard support is here! View the top 10 global high scores under records!!
[*] Gamepad support!
[*] Pause screen fixes for various issues pausing caused while shooting a vine and other pause fixes.
[/list]
